# `schema-title-changed`

Schema title changed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `sdk` |
| **Default severity** | `info` · `--profile sdk`: `warn` |
| **Rule IDs** | `schema-title-changed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M5) |
| **Group** | References and components ([RULES.md section 8](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A schema's `title` changed.

## Why this default

Some SDK generators name types after the title.

## Example

From test case [`schema-title-changed`](../../test/cases/schema-title-changed/): A schema title changed: some generators name types after it.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
          name:
            type: string
-       title: Pet
+       title: Animal
```

Findings:

- `schema-title-changed` · info · #/components/schemas/Pet

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  schema-title-changed: info
```

## How to fix

Keep the old title if SDK compatibility matters.
